new_press_releases.title: Thermo Fisher Scientific Completes Sale of its Microbiology Business to Astorg
new_press_releases.summary: Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. (NYSE: TMO), the world leader in serving science, today announced that it has completed the sale of its microbiology business to Astorg, a leading pan-European private equity firm, for consideration of approximately $1.075 billion, consisting of cash and a $50 million seller note.

new_press_releases.title: Thermo Fisher Scientific Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
new_press_releases.summary: Thermo paired higher Analytical Instruments revenue and margin with AI-enabled Orbitrap launches and new bioprocess and proteomics customer infrastructure.
pmInsights: Portfolio economics: Analytical Instruments revenue increased 6.9% to $1.847 billion; segment income increased 30.5% to $424 million and margin expanded 4.2 points to 23.0%.

Product direction: Orbitrap Tribrid Apex and Excedion pair AI-driven analytics with multiomics, structural biology, biopharma characterization, small-molecule analysis and hard-to-detect drug-development targets.
Commercial model: the Plainville Bioprocess Design Center and PRECISE-SG100K collaboration extend Thermo into pharma and biotech co-development and integrated Olink plus Orbitrap Astral proteomics.
new_press_releases.watersPmImplication: Assess Thermo at the workflow level—separations and MS, analytics, application proof and customer co-development—not on instrument specifications alone.
new_press_releases.evidenceBoundary: The release does not separate LC or chromatography revenue, unit growth, pricing or market share; Analytical Instruments performance is not evidence of LC share gain.

new_press_releases.title: Thermo Fisher Scientific Announces Quarterly Dividend
new_press_releases.summary: Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. (NYSE: TMO), the world leader in serving science, today announced that its Board of Directors authorized a quarterly cash dividend of $0.47 per common share, payable on October 15, 2026, to shareholders of record as of September 15, 2026.

new_press_releases.summary: Thermo Fisher scheduled its Q2 2026 earnings call for Thursday, July 23, 2026, and will hold a conference call on the same day at 8:30 a.m. ET.
